notes: Run 8: normal fresh creation on the fixed RECAP case, operator-authorised batch of 8 admitted model calls. No runtime binding is pre-filled and the prompt does not require a script entry, so the delivered entry is resolved by the official flow (caller binding absent -> author declaration -> conservative recognition, ambiguity stays refused). Native stages keep the Codex CLI (https, medium, default). runtime_defaults route the structured planner/association/diagnosis calls to the DeepSeek API: api_model is pinned to deepseek-v4-pro, api_retries=0, one total deadline per call, streaming with the documented completion marker. limits.model_calls=8 covers entry association, association review and planning repair as well; model_timeout=600 per call and limits.total_seconds=3600 bound the batch including build and business acceptance. The 240 s silence window is observed only (execution.progress_watch=observe). Any Docker build or business acceptance failure stops the batch; no restart or resume.
